EXPERIMENT LADDER — run in this order; stop funding a branch when its kill gate fires.
E0 Contract/schema threat harness (days, before framework): define immutable PrivateDeckContext vs PublishedDeckArtifact, role sessions, per-stream state, command/receipt/tombstone schemas. Property/fault model covers duplicate/out-of-order/gap/restart/CAS takeover. PASS: deterministic terminal state across generated schedules; no unauthorized subscription/read; restart recovers snapshots. Architecture blocker until pass.
E1 Two-site noninterference spike: separate static origins/BFF sockets, seed unique private canaries, hostile Stage XSS simulation attacks cookie/storage/SW/API/WSS/topic; inspect HTTP/WSS/DOM/cache/log/error/telemetry. PASS: 0 canary bytes + demonstrable network/credential reachability denial. Timing/size use bounded differential traces, not absolute equality. Any private path means redesign, not sanitization patch.
E2 Device-binding vertical slice: pre-auth private phone binds clean-profile Stage using non-authorizing display_join_id; include expired/replayed/photographed code, wrong deck, concurrent bind, revoke, takeover, process restart. PASS: no code yields controller scope; exactly one binding wins; old sockets close; wrong epoch rejected; unassisted ready >=80% within 90s (pilot), reconnect p95 <=2s, command applied p95 <=500ms at venue.
E3 Real display drill: Windows Chrome/Edge Extended, Duplicate, single-screen; popup blocked, fullscreen exit, monitor unplug, Win+P Extended->Duplicate while recording projector. PASS: public Stage survives/recoverable; any private pixel on projector disqualifies co-resident Console from zero-leak mode. Overall fresh-browser audience-ready >=85%, median <=3m, p90 <=5m.
E4 Canonical deck corpus: 3 representative Korean PPTX/PDF decks (fonts, charts, notes, scanned content), extract/render/re-upload/mutate. PASS: immutable deckVersion+manifestHash, deterministic slide identity policy, accepted render fidelity, private notes never enter PublishedDeckArtifact. Failures decide selective OCR/VLM or unsupported warning; do not silently degrade.
E5 Causal STT fusion: prerecorded Korean corpus with slide changes inside/before finalization, numbers/names/code-switch/noise across providers. PASS: chosen provider/error thresholds set from product needs; 100% candidates bind correct slideSeq or AMBIGUOUS; no partial promotes; final-to-eligible p95 <=5s under target network. No provider decision before bake-off.
E6 RAG/publication adversary: cross-tenant docs, ACL revoke between retrieval/approval, stale deck/source hashes, prompt injection, SSRF, PII, unknown rights, numeric/date/entity traps. PASS: unauthorized result/publication 0; wrong numeric/date/entity publication 0; false-SUPPORT <=1% before live public pilot; every publish has causal envelope and tombstone/withdrawal. Otherwise keep search private/pre-approved only.
E7 Human-value trial: baseline slides vs pre-approved cards vs live candidates. PASS live-public only if >=30% relevant candidate use, approval median <=2s/p90 <=5s, <=1 induced pause/10m, workload increase <1/7, comprehension/source recall +>=10% with core recall decline <5%. Else kill live-public, keep presenter-private.
E8 Auto placement: compare Tier1 vs manual after rehearsal. PASS only if >=95% supported-machine success, >=20s setup saving, zero privacy incidents; failure >5% kills marketed feature.
summary: Uncertainty retirement experiments with exact gates
